description: The voices and styles of the multi-speaker model (lib/models/voiceModel.js) - the design record (each voice's archetype) of lib/synthesis.js's voice and style tables, which speak them (test/testSynthesis.js checks that the tables match it). A voice is one speaker of the model's speaker table (its key - one voice of the local TTS model the voice model was trained from, train/data/train.json's tts voices). A style applies parameter transforms (transform - lib/transforms.js, applied after the voice's) and a rate (the speed, 1 is the voice's own); neutral applies none.

voices.label: Male
voices.description: A warm, buoyant male voice over a resonant mid-low core - the default.

voices.label: Female
voices.description: A modern, confident, and friendly female voice.

voices.label: Sarah
voices.description: A cheerful female voice with real resonance under it, personable and decisive.

voices.label: Helen
voices.description: A low, grounded female voice, quick to the point, with a sincere tone.

voices.label: Amy
voices.description: A young, playful, and upbeat female voice.

voices.label: Kate
voices.description: A settled, even-toned, and kind female voice with crisp consonants.

voices.label: Grace
voices.description: A rounded, soft-edged female voice with an easy, relaxed delivery.

voices.label: James
voices.description: A resonant, decisive male voice with a wide dynamic range.

voices.label: Robert
voices.description: A trim, focused male voice with a steady, low-set core.

voices.label: Michael
voices.description: A buoyant, energetic male voice with a playful lift at the ends of phrases.

voices.label: David
voices.description: A punchy, close male voice with crisp consonants and a pitch that lifts across each line.

styles.label: Neutral
styles.description: The voice as designed - plain narration.

styles.label: Sad
styles.description: A quieter, lower, flatter, and slower voice.

styles.label: Fearful
styles.description: A breathy, quieter, much higher, and quicker voice.

styles.label: Disgusted / contemptuous
styles.description: A pressed, quieter, lower, and much slower voice.

styles.label: Soft
styles.description: A quieter voice, a little slower.

styles.label: Shouting
styles.description: A pressed, bright, raised voice, a little louder - its consonants with it.

styles.label: Dialogue
styles.description: Neutral dialogue - a little higher, brighter, and quicker than the narration (style auto's quotations).

styles.label: Exclaim
styles.description: An exclamation - the dialogue style livelier: louder, wider in pitch, and quicker (style auto's exclaimed quotations).
